verdict.rationale: Bruno is a local, offline API client and testing tool for sending requests, running collections and serving mock responses. Routing, load-balancing and transforming live traffic between consumers and upstream services is an API-gateway capability outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Bruno running as a proxy or gateway; its pre-request scripts and mock responses only shape its own test requests.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can route, load-balance, and transform requests between consumers and upstream services
